name: next-unread
description: Conductor-style unread threads for the Claude desktop app: a notice when another thread finishes or asks a question while you were elsewhere, and Option+L to jump to it.

key.title: Jump key
key.description: The character that jumps to the next unread thread when typed in the prompt box. The default ¬ is what Option+L types on a US or Dutch Mac keyboard, so Option+L jumps. A letter or digit only jumps from an empty prompt box. Empty turns the key off; the button and /next-unread keep working.
